arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Stanford's advocate stated the Bayh-Dole Act comprehensively disposes of rights in federally funded inventions.
The government's advocate noted Stanford and government interests align but may not always do so.
Roche's advocate stated the Federal Circuit did not reach certain questions on remand.
